preconditions.description: Number of vertices n is between 2 and 500.
Number of edges m is between 1 and the minimum of n*(n-1) and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) has vertices u and v within the range [1, n] and u is not equal to v.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if can_make_acyclic_by_removing_one_edge(n, edges) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if it is possible to make the graph acyclic by removing at most one edge, otherwise 'NO'.
